name: Settings Manager
author: Uwe Bruckhaus
description: Manage your installed Omarchy plugins in one window, laid out like a settings app: every plugin grouped by in the bar, running in the background or not in use; put widgets in or out of the bar and move them along it; edit the settings stored in their bar entries; check and install updates of their git checkouts; remove plugins; and find and install new ones from the marketplace catalog. Every change goes through Omarchy's own plugin commands.
